representativeService.normalization: each target's kernel price is divided by that target's scalar integer-add service cost
representativeService.rule: an equal-weight median within each ISA family, then an equal-weight median of the family results, rounded upward
representativeService.evenSizedMedian: the exact arithmetic mean of the middle two values
representativeService.cohort: every target listed under targets; the cohort and this rule are what a revision of either changes
representativeService.scope: these are semantic service prices for an abstract machine, not an elapsed-time prediction and not an upper bound on every sampled physical processor

instructionService.method: llvm-mca --instruction-info over the instruction forms of the Native AOT reference lowering, per pinned evidence target; an instruction form the target's scheduling model does not serve is unresolved evidence, never zero and never one
instructionService.excludedWork: a continuation that ends in a managed throw is excluded: the reference kernels refuse by returning, and the throw's own object construction, stack walk and unwind are unmodeled rather than silently zero
